verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's homepage says the product "moves cases between agents and your team." Because agents are listed separately from the team, this implies built-in agents that cases can be handed to, but it is a single marketing line with no detail. The "customizable automation" claim is general workflow automation, not an AI assistant. missing for 10: documentation of a named built-in AI assistant or agent, how users delegate tasks to it, which tasks it can perform, its controls and limits, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: It automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team, and keeps every decision defensible.
